title: Who played with Jimmy Noone: Earl Hines, Joe Poston, Zutti Singleton
summary: Allen proposes pianists and sidemen who might have worked with Noone; she cannot recall and says her husband would know better.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Do you remember who was working with Jimmy Noon at that time?

I can't recall who all was working. I think let's see. Let me try to think. Let's see. Who was working with Jimmy Noon. If my husband was here he could tell you better than I because he frequented those places more so than I did. And uh.
Well I wondered if Jerome Carrington might have been playing piano with Jimmy Noon. He may have.

Because soon after Earl Hines came in. Uh. Just about this period Earl Hines uh began playing piano. Previously Glover Comptonized. Yes. But between Compton and Hines. Yeah. I never established who it was. Yeah. Uh huh.
Uh huh. And I can't recall.
Did you know Joe Poston who the alto sax player he might have been with Jimmy Noon.
I know of him. I think Zutti Singleton too.
Zutti Lidas. Very likely. I was playing on the drums. Zutti soon after joined uh probably Carol Dickerson. Probably so. And uh. Yeah.
